  <Page title="Opacity & Z-index" lede="Stacking order for layered UI, and opacity roles.">
    <Section title="Z-index">
      <TokenTable tokens={select('primitives.number', 'z-index/')} mode={modeOf(globals)} />
    </Section>
    <Section title="Opacity">
      <TokenTable tokens={[...select('semantic.opacity'), ...select('primitives.opacity')]} mode={modeOf(globals)} />
    </Section>
    <Section title="Stroke width & breakpoints">
      <TokenTable tokens={[...select('semantic.dimension', 'stroke-width/'), ...select('primitives.number', 'stroke-width/'), ...select('primitives.number', 'breakpoint/')]} mode={modeOf(globals)} />

);
